Documentation-only release. There are no behaviour changes; numeric results are
identical to 0.1.0.

## Changes

- Rewrote the README for package users: install, quick start, the full function
  list, result helpers and plotting, instead of the porting project's internal
  phases.
- Moved development and release instructions to `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- Described the deliberate differences from R's DFBA in the README, with links
  to `DECISION.md` and `COVERAGE.md`.
- Removed the "Phase 1 / Phase 2" vocabulary from the package docstrings too.
- Added the PyPI version badge.

PyPI renders the project description from `README.md`, so this release also
refreshes the [PyPI project page](https://pypi.org/project/dfbayes/).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MichaelStavreff/dfbayes/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
